If that agent is later proven fraudulent, the bond is slashed and the voucher's on-ledger record takes a sable mark. So 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 real vouchers each risking 500 POA, 500,000 POA exposed. The emission nectar an attacker chases is trivial beside that forfeit, and honest members won't step past their own risk ledge to vouch for anonymous strangers.
